fact: The UNDP/EU justice support programme (implemented 14 February 2020 to 14 December 2024) developed a prototype case management system (SGIPJ) for flagrant-delit cases at the Tribunal de Première Instance, validated on 27-28 November 2024, which is not yet deployed or operational.
title: Programme d'appui à la justice en République de Djibouti - Rapport final
